trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are done. No online play, no DLC and no second run are needed.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum pops by itself the instant the last one unlocks — there is nothing extra to do for it.
Work the six stages in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers, crime, money and the final sweep.
Do not chase online or DLC trophies — there are none. Everything is single-player. [1] [6]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: the 100% checklist that opens after the story. It is not a true 100% — most of it is partial credit, closer to 60% of the game.

steps.t: Finish the story first. The checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — anything you did during the story already counts. [1] [2]
Complete any 100 optional missions. There are far more than 100 in the game, including purple icons and black icons with pink letters. [1]
Scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app, and study any 100 of 255 animals through binoculars. [1]
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the ten hardest. [1] [2]
Clear every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, every underwater discovery, every shooting range and drone race, and all of Bret's target decks — the only lines that demand the full set. [1] [6]
Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything stays doable in free-roam after the story. [1]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count. Under the Bridges are the quickest — but do not stop at 250 if you are chasing 100%, which wants 300.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. Mix the four kinds however you like — the total is what counts. [1] [2]
The four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. [1] [2]
Under the Bridges are the quickest to clear, so start there if you want the silver fast. [1]
Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. [1] [2]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy that can pass you by: 18 meditations at 10 spots, and the very first one only exists in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. Do it the morning after Down to Earth.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 1 meditation first: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. [1]
That first meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so whether it is required is still unclear — do it anyway, it costs nothing. [1]
Meditate at the other spots: 18 meditations across 10 locations in total. Each spot counts +2 if you do it with both Jason and Lucia. [1]
The last spot only opens once both characters can be played together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. [1]
A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played — wait for it before walking away. [2]
Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, or on the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida. [1] [2]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break out of the heat zone. A train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy escape.

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — that is when both characters can free-roam together. [1]
Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level. [1]
Escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. [1]
The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… [1]

trophies.guide: Three shops in a row with your partner, while the police stay on you the whole time. The three jewellery stores in north Vice City are the tidy spot.

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together. [1]

Keep the red and blue flashing wanted level the whole time — do not let it drop to the red heat level, and do not lose it between shops. [1]

A good spot is the 3 jewellery stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth. [1]

trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm. It slows time and marks weak spots, but drains the purple focus bar in a few seconds. [1]
